title: Ope Ope no Mi
facts: Appearance (fan wikis, via search): a red, heart-shaped fruit that resembles a strawberry, swirl-patterned surface, stem with a swirling end pointing upwards
Paramecia, English name Op-Op Fruit: the user creates a spherical 'Room' and acts like a surgeon inside it
Inside a Room the user can cut anything apart without killing it (Room / Amputate)
Shambles swaps the positions of things inside the Room, including people
Mes removes a person's heart in a cube; the person stays alive
Gamma Knife destroys a body's insides without an outer wound
Perennial Youth Operation grants eternal youth at the cost of the user's life
Corazon (Donquixote Rosinante) stole the fruit (worth 5 billion berries) to save young Law, and it cured Law's Amber Lead Syndrome
'Always win at musical chairs' is a joke line (Shambles)
